mods.name: Hide Beat Grid
mods.author: dnlsndr
mods.summary: Hides the waveform beat rulers for beatmatching practice.
mods.description:
Clears EP147's 1220x15 beat-ruler images above and below the waveforms. The waveform, BPM, cues and audio are unchanged; you can practice matching by ear without using the grid.

The core owns makeGridImage when Bright Grid/Day Mode is active, so the mod writes settings/azmod-gridaa.off and needs one Reload after installation to claim the hook. Bright Grid and Day Mode cannot be used at the same time.

mods.name: Record Streaming
mods.author: dnlsndr
mods.summary: Keeps MASTER REC running while a streaming service plays.
mods.description:
Removes the streaming-service block from the deck's USB recorder: MASTER REC can start with a streaming track loaded, and loading one does not stop an active recording.

It hooks the recorder's startable check and its reason notification on EP147 2.00 only (ep147-9e9454e357389ece). The other checks (recording device, Bluetooth input, a track still loading) are left unchanged. No firmware bytes are included; the mod verifies the hooked code's 16-byte fingerprint before claiming it.
